strips.title: Checking a deal — in real life

panels.head: The banner
panels.text: “Was $249.99, now $179.99!” Before you tap, ignore the crossed-out number.

panels.head: Three stores, one model
panels.text: Apple charges $249. Other stores sat at $180–$220 for months. $179.99 is good, not 28% good.

panels.head: The trap
panels.text: The cheaper one on the next shelf says Pro 2. Different earbuds, different deal.

panels.head: Buy, keep the receipt
panels.text: Under your number? Buy where a later drop is paid back, and keep the receipt to January.
